# HEATPUMPSPECS

> Evidence-based, machine-readable technical specifications for domestic heat pumps, focused on the Irish and EU markets.

HEATPUMPSPECS is the background, evidence-led data layer of the wider TechSpecs project. Its purpose is to make reliable, traceable heat-pump technical information readily available to SEAI, technical professionals, researchers and machine/AI retrieval systems. It is intended to be useful independently of any commercial transaction. Product records follow the TechSpecs Canonical Data Standard v2.0. Original source evidence, source URLs, model applicability and verification status are retained.

The separate planned consumer-facing website is https://www.heatpumpspecs.ie. That site is intended for consumer information, lead generation and affiliate activity. It may use the repository as its evidence base, but commercial relationships do not determine technical facts or verification status. This repository is not an SEAI database or an official SEAI publication, and no SEAI endorsement is implied.

Project architecture: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/docs/project-architecture.md

## Primary machine-readable resources

- [Product catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/catalogue.json): index of all V2 product records.
- [V2 JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/schemas/product-record-v2.schema.json): canonical product-record schema.
- [V2 data standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/docs/canonical-data-standard-v2.md): extraction, provenance, normalization and validation rules.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS): repository purpose and layout.

## Product records

All nine Grant Engineering (Ireland) ULC subtypes in the current KEYMARK source inventory now have archival-first-pass V2 product records: five Aerona R290 models and four Aerona³ R32 models.

- [Grant Aerona HPR290i40](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i40.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i65](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i65.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i90](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i90.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i120](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i120.json)
- [Grant Aerona HPR290i160](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona-hpr290i160.json)
- [Grant Aerona³ HPID6R32](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona3-hpid6r32.json)
- [Grant Aerona³ HPID10R32](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona3-hpid10r32.json)
- [Grant Aerona³ HPID13R32](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona3-hpid13r32.json)
- [Grant Aerona³ HPID17R32](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heatpumpspecs-pixel/HEATPUMPSPECS/main/data/grant/heat-pump/aerona3-hpid17r32.json)

These are source-preserving archival first passes; normalized specifications have not yet been populated. The four R32 certificates are dated 1 March 2022 and do not display an expiry date in the retrieved one-page PDFs; current certificate status and current product availability must be checked separately.

## Interpretation rules

- Prefer exact model/variant matches over family-level claims.
- Preserve manufacturer, regulatory and third-party evidence separately.
- Do not infer a product specification from another model in the same family.
- Treat differing test standards, climate zones, flow temperatures and definitions as distinct data.
- A KEYMARK certificate is not to be represented as an SEAI grant approval.
- Structural validation does not establish factual accuracy.

The catalogue currently uses the public GitHub raw-content endpoint. A custom publishing host can be configured later without changing product records.
